MATCH (s:Supplier {id: $s})-[:SUPPLIES]->(start:Material) WHERE $m IS NULL OR start.id = $m
               CALL apoc.path.subgraphNodes(start, {relationshipFilter: 'COMPONENT_OF>', maxLevel: $d}) YIELD node
               WITH start, node WHERE node.type = 'FG'
               MATCH p = shortestPath((start)-[:COMPONENT_OF*..20]->(node))
               OPTIONAL MATCH (node)-[:IS_PACKAGED_AS]->(pp:PackagedProduct)
               RETURN node.id AS finished_good, node.name AS product, node.ndc_dashed AS ndc_dashed, pp.ndc11 AS ndc11,

                      [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS example_path
